batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b UT Yadav

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AD Russell b UT Yadav

balls.text: it had been a terrific over till this ball, but the final one is a length delivery, a swish of the bat, not even off the middle of the bat but still clears Warner at mid-on for six, perfect finish for Mumbai
skips away from leg stump and carves the ball towards sweeper cover
outside off and that is slugged towards long-on
only a single this time, down the ground

van der Merwe to bowl the final over, he almost has a wicket off the first ball, a miscue from Pollard sends the ball towards sweeper cover, Nadeem puts down his second catch of the match, barely gets his hands on that, he was on his knees and sliding as he attempted to take that, in the confusion Pollard has charged back for the second, Rayudu has barely begun to run, Pollard screams at him to sprint

looks for another six as he got a full toss, Rohit looks to clear long-on, hits very low on the bat so he doesn't get the power he wants, Russell takes an overhead catch at long-on to end a superb innings from Rohit
superb hitting from Rohit, seriously stylish, length ball outside off,  he flicks that over wide long-on for six, terrific timing, lifts the back leg in Caribbean style to top it off
short of length ball is hammered towards deep midwicket
badly mistimed as he clubs the ball down the ground

whoah! unbelievable hit from Pollard, a slower shorter ball from Umesh, Pollard goes for the pull, the bottom hand comes off the bat as he plays that, still there is monstrous amount of power behind that shot and it races away to the square-leg boundary
shortish ball is powered towards midwicket
slugged towards midwicket to end another profitable over for Mumbai
nonsense bowling from Agarkar, a knee-high full toss outside off, launched out of the park by Rohit, who is again showing just how good he is in the IPL
well outside off, looked like a wide, not given, Rohit isn't too happy
slower ball doesn't rise up at all and Rohit can't connect
that was in the air for a long, long time as Rohit swipes it towards deep midwicket, it was a slower ball from Ajit, that sials past the midwicket rope for six, a man beyond the rope shells the catch
full and wide outside off
short ball is slapped towards towards long-on, Pollard wanted two but quickly says no, no, no as Warner charges in from long-on
full ball is drilled towards long-on for a single, just two off the over, top stuff from Umesh
short of length ball outside off, Pollard looks to slap it through the off side, he misses, I thought there was some sound, but none of the fielders appeal
lovely delivery from Umesh, a fast yorker, 144.5kph, Rohit does well to keep that out, manages to guide it to third man, terrific over so far from Umesh
third dot ball in a row, second slower ball of the over, outside off and Rohit can't connect
well done by Umesh, full, wide slower ball, Tendulkar was looking to power every delivery, he has to reach out for this one, only manages to slice it to Warner at extra cover, gone for 54 off 47
length ball outside off, Tendulkar moves away from leg stump, too far to be able to connect with the ball
whipped towards the leg side for one more
a heave towards midwicket, badly mistimed, a single results
slapped towards cover for a single
whoah! what a shot that is, the crowd goes bonkers as SRT hits another six, this was just helped along by Tendulkar, not trying to power the ball, moves across and paddles it over fine leg
low full toss on off stump, helped down to fine leg for a couple
slower ball from Agarkar, 112.5kph, Tendulkar moving about a lot around the crease, he wasn't quite in position to take advantage of this one, looked to run it down to third man but misses
not really what you want to see, Tendulkar looking to slog, an ungainly shot towards long-off, flat-batted that one for a single

that seemed a certain wicket when it left Rohit's bat, he flat-batted that short of length ball, top edge over the bowler's head and it lands exactly between long-on and long-off, a few yards to either side and one of the fielders would have taken that
rubbish bowling from Irfan, a nice, hit-me full toss outside off, crashed through point for four to bring up his half-century
short of length ball just outside off, Tendulkar moves across and wants to paddle it, can't connect, a leg-bye results
length ball and outside off, Rohit steers that towards third man for a single, as usual Rohit Sharma looking at his best in the IPL
Irfan provides some cannon fodder there, short of length and it sits up, swatted away to cow corner for four
length ball is driven towards long-off for a single
power from Rohit, a full toss is dispatched, that wasn't too far from where long-on was, but it was travelling so fast that Warner couldn't stop that
swept towards square leg, Tendulkar looking more and more adventurous
full and flat, heading for middle, Tendulkar has switched to all-out attack now, skipping away from the stumps, powers the ball but not past cover
chipped over the bowler's head for a couple, Tendulkar sashays down the track to play that one
length ball outside off, slapped powerfully towards mid-off

is that a run-out? a short of length ball is drilled towards mid-off by Tendulkar, they set off for a single, Rohit wasn't at his quickest, perhaps expecting the throw to go to the non-striker's end, instead Warner fires it at the keeper's end, needed a direct hit to get him out, Rohit's dive saves him before the keeper can take off the bails
keeps it on the short side, wide as well, SRT should have put that away, instead slaps it towards van der Merwe at point
short and down the leg side, 142.7kph but a wide
Rohit moves across and opens the face to steer the ball to third man

an ungainly heave, just the sort of shot that works best in T20s, it was a short and outside off, Rohit slaps it over the bowler's head for four, for a moment I thought that would be caught by long-on but it was too wide for the fielder
full ball on the pads, 127.8kph, chipped towards wide long-on, Tendulkar scampers back for the second
lashed down the ground by Rohit, driven powerfully on the up past extra cover, Warner dived to try stop that but it was much too quick for him
Rohit skips down the track and caresses that towards long-off
full and down the leg side, went for the lap sweep, doesn't connect as well as he did earlier in the game, the ball dribbles towards short fine
another drive towards long-off for one more
driven down the ground for a single
dropped, a regulation caught-and-bowled chance, and that is put down by Nadeem, nice height and not to fast, hits him on the tip of the fingers, Tendulkar survives
Nadeem bowling his final, Tendulkar can't get that away to the leg side as he wanted

full toss from Russell, poor ball and it gets the treatment, dismisses it over square leg for a six, and the run-rate perks up above 6, and Russell continues to find it difficult to stop the runs, 13 off his first
length ball on the pads, nudged towards midwicket
defended in front of point for a single

shortish ball, Tendulkar shuffles across and pulls that down towards fine leg, well struck by SRT, seemed headed only for a single, but Umesh can't cut it off, should have stopped that, Delhi's ground fielding not at its best today
full ball on legstump, driven towards long-on
on the pads, clipped to square leg for a single, 132kph
length ball on middle stump, defended towards the bowler
Rohit brings out the sweep, down towards fine leg
defended towards cover
Tendulkar skips away from the leg stump and lofts the ball towards long-on, as my colleague Shiva points out, another century for SRT, 100 runs in the season
on the pads, clipped towards midwicket
can't time the ball at all as he looks to drive the ball through the off
worked to the leg side for a single, Mumbai finally getting a move on now, though the run-rate remains a shade below six
sensational hit from Rohit, who again shows why people rate him so highly, a flighted ball is cleanly struck over the bowler's head for six, effortlessly done
defended towards point
length ball on leg stump, tucked to short fine for one more
length ball sliding down the leg side, played from well within the crease towards midwicket
van der Merwe returns, driven towards long-off for a single
length ball, played wristily towards midwicket, Tendulkar called for two initially but has to settle for one
length ball is pushed to the right of Nadeem, who dives but can't stop that, Nadeem's quite a good fielder but this was too far even for him

Tendulkar was already in position for the lap sweep, plays the ball very fine, too fine for the man at short fine leg, and that's four more to SRT, points the bat at the umpire to make sure he gets four runs, and that it isn't signalled leg-byes
length ball on middle and off, carefully played from within the crease
Nadeem is back, he starts with a length ball on the leg stump, worked behind square for a single
punched towards long-on for a quick couple, Ajit Agarkar remains reliably expensive, 11 off his first over
there's what the crowd wants to see, a short ball from Ajit and that is pulled away superbly by Tendulkar, who swivels as he plays that shot, all the way into the crowd
shorter this time, square driven towards point by Tendulkar
fuller this time, speed gun says 113kph but didn't seem that slow, defended towards point for a single
Tendulkar drives on the up, not timed too well, ball rolls to the right of the fielder towards long-on
length ball from Agarkar, whipped towards midwicket
short of length and outside off, steered down to third man for a single, 24 for 2 after the Powerplay, in which Mumbai have struggled to find the boundary, just two fours, that too one off a misfield
short of length ball is slapped towards square leg, Mumbai struggling to find any momentum here
fuller and just outside off, driven towards extra cover, Rohit wanted one Tendulkar didn't, he screams 'No,' and Rohit has to rush back, no direct hit so Rohit is fine
short of length once more, 144.5kph, slapped towards cover by Rohit
short of length ball worked towards the leg side

what luck for Delhi, Dinesh Karthik is gone after a terrific Tendulkar straight drive deflects off  the bowler Umesh Yadav's hand on to the stumps, Mumbai's most prolific batsman of the season is gone, is Sir Viv the lucky charm?
short of length ball on leg stump, Karthik was advancing down the track, can't connect well enough and he sends the ball towards backward square leg
worked towards cover point for a quick single
short of length ball, more sloppy fielding from Delhi here, that was a driven towards mid-on where Ajit Agarkar, usually one of the safest fielders, dives over the ball, Irfan's mood doesn't improve
defended back towards the bowler

on the pads, Tendulkar clips it to short fine leg for a single, oh hang on, there are overthrows, Russell who was backing up doesn't stop the ball cleanly, Russell sprints after the ball as quickly as anyone does in world cricket, and dives brilliantly to stop the ball from reaching the rope, doesn't impress Irfan though
short of length ball just outside off, 124.5kph, Karthik opens the face and steers the ball down to third man for a single
pushed towards mid-off for a single to end a successful over for Mumbai
blocks it once more, van der Merwe keeping it on the stumps, not giving much for the batsman to work with
more defence, down the track
watchfully defended by Dinesh Karthik, who comes in at No. 3, no sign of Ponting yet

tries to repeat and he's gone, Roelof strikes in his first over of the season, Mumbai made a change at the top of the order, but there's no difference in the result, another early wicket, and there's been no quick start either, Smith can't get this one over the man at mid-off, Umesh Yadav doesn't grab it on the first attempt, parries it high and settles under to collect on the second attempt
launches that over mid-off for the first four of the innings
looks to whip the legstump ball towards square leg but the ball rolls towards point instead
length ball on middle and off, blocked back towards the bowler, Irfan moves to his left to cut that off
again Roelof makes a diving stop at point
Tendulkar skips down the track, drives firmly towards cover, can't find the gap
on the pads, pitched up, eased towards long-on
length ball on off stump from Irfan, 125.6kph, defended back to the bowler
defended towards extra cover to end another quiet over
towards the pads once more, not much turn on offer, pushed towards mid-on
length ball on middle and leg, more carefully working to the leg side, one more single
length ball on the pads, tucked towards deep midwicket for a single
length ball on off, pushed off the front foot towards extra cover
Shahbaz Nadeem has been Delhi's best bowler this season, he starts with a ball on the middle and leg, clipped towards square leg for a single
closer to the off stump, defended from the crease to the off side
pitched up and outside off, Smith shoulders arms
length ball outside off, towards extra cover, Tendulkar wanted one but Russell is onto the ball quickly and Tendulkar has to turn back
seams in after pitching back of a length, defended behind square leg for a single
pushes this one towards cover and sets off for a quick single
bit of inward movement first up from Irfan, defended down the track by Smith

it's over, Delhi snap their losing streak, Sehwag finishes it off in style, a swipe to the square leg boundary consigns Mumbai to their second consecutive defeat, both massive ones as well, and Warner after many months finishes on the winning side, he lost all four Tests against India, six IPL matches and at least one T20 against Sri Lanka
a height no-ball that one, that was a loopy full toss outside off, scores level
length ball is placed towards midwicket, there could have been two runs if they sprinted, Sehwag was happy with ambling through for a single
full and on the pads, easy put away this, glanced down to fine leg for four
full and wide outside off, WArner reaches out but can't reach it, wide ball
looks to hammer that one out of the park, pitched outside leg and struck the pad
deftly done by Sehwag, arches back and deflects the ball down to third man

on the pads, whipped towards short fine leg, was a tight single, Sehwag was motoring through, but he gave up towards the end as Tendulkar's through came in, the throw was wide, Sehwga smiles, as does Tendulkar
a low full toss and that is sent towards extra cover for a single, this is the first time Warner is not opening in the IPL

at last reward for Malinga, another scorcher of a delivery that was heading for the base of the stumps, Jayawradene was struck on the boot in front of middle stump, massive appeal for lbw, Jayawardene seems to have walked here, umpire raises his finger later
short of length ball is whipped behind square leg for one more, 151-0 once more
driven along the ground to extra cover for an easy single
swatted towards wide long-on for a single
a terrific delivery from Malinga but it has ended up costing four runs, a yorker on off and middle, Sehwag bends his knees and get his bat down in time, squeezes it past the keeper for four
guided down to third man for a single, Sehwag 16 away from a 100, Delhi 18 away from victory
is that the first false shot of the innings? a thick outside edge past the keeper for four, Pollard had his arm up in appeal before seeing the ball fly past the keeper
lashed that one! super hit from Sehwag, at Pollard's pace and Sehwag in this murderous mood length balls are no good, powered through extra cover for four, terrific placement as well
slower, short of a length, angling in, guided towards point
short ball and that is swatted towards wide long-on by Sehwag, drops well short of the fielder
oh, here comes Pollard, inside-edged down the pitch
length ball on the pads, helped along to fine leg
clipped towards wide mid-on for a single
length ball is defended off the front foot to the bowler
too short and on leg stump, pulled away powerfully towards the Mumbai dug-out once more, a stylish swivel to finish off the stroke
slower ball, between bat and pad after Jayawardene skips away from leg stump, throug to the keeper
Sehwag is proving unstoppable in the region behind point, another single
short from Harbhajan, hoicked towards wide long-on for a single, Pollard fields
toying with Harbhajan here, the bowler looped this one and on middle and leg, Sehwag skips away from the stumps and places it perfectly behind point to pick up another four
backs away and sends that short of length ball to the backward point boundary, brings up 2000 runs in IPL as well
length ball is worked towards midwicket, Sehwag shouts No, no as Mahela looks for a quick second
another single, carved towards deep point, all gone calm now
moves across and turns it to midwicket for a single
there's the half-century for Mahela, a comfortable single towards wide mid-on, 34 balls it took
that one bounces extra, Jayawardene surprised, he manages to defend that towards mid-off, a legcutter from Munaf
tapped towards long-on for one more, this could be the middle over of an ODI the way Delhi are batting this over
shortish ball outside off, slapped to Rohit once more
Sehwag arches back and slices that towards point, lands just short of Rohit at backward point
eased to long-on for a single, all too easy now for delhi
poor ball that, a full toss on the pads, clipped down to deep backward square leg, a let-off for Malinga there, that was a four-ball
a yorker heading for the boots of Jayawardene, who does well to get his front leg out of the way and dig the ball to the leg side
driven down the ground, Mumbai seem to have no answer to this onslaught from Delhi
full ball on middle, drills that yorker towards long-on for a single
a slower one from Malinga, guided down to third man
beautiful drive from Jayawardene, a length ball outside off is eased past extra cover for four, and without too much fuss Jayawardene is scoring at a strike-rate of 170
short of length ball is dropped towards point for a quick single, 14 off that over
shortish ball and that is pulled towards midwicket
length ball is driven towards long-on for a single that brings up the 100
that is paddle-swept for a big six, Jayawradene sends that over the Mumbai dug-out for six, a glum Mumbai squad watches the ball fly over them
shorter this time, and on off stump, a wristy stroke sends the ball towards square leg
Sehwag is in a tearing hurry, here carves that length ball over point for four
exposes all three stumps as he backs away, slaps that shortish ball towards cover where Ponting makes a diving stop
full ball, moves across and eases it towards mid-on for a single
spun away after pitching short, Sehwag slaps it towards point
from round the wicket, guided towards point
length ball is firmly swept away towards deep backward square leg, totally in control there
defended down the track by Jayawardene
driven towards long-off for a single, can't see how Mumbai can come back in this
fifty for Sehwag, he backs away and slashes it towards third man, his first half-century in 10 IPL innings
full ball on the pads, Sehwag pummels that over wide long-on for six, all too easy this for Delhi, Sehwag has sprinted to 49
length ball heading for middle, worked towards cover
is that a beamer, yes is it, slipped out of smith's arm and Sehwag was surprised by it, manages to defend it towards the bowler
shortish and just outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
Jayawardene misses as he looks to slice a short of length ball towards point
nudged towards square leg for one more
spins in from back of a length, Sehwag waits on the back foot and slaps it towards long-on
length ball outside off, slashed towards deep point
pitched up and that is eased for a single
the reverse-sweep now, Jayawardene plays it fine and third man has no chance, Delhi fans enjoying themselves
Mumbai turn to Harbhajan in an attempt to stop the runs, slapped towards point first up
lovely delivery to end the over, that was full and heading for middle, defended down the track
full and fast, squeezed down to short fine leg
short of length ball just outside off, no stopping Sehwag here, slicing this past backward point for four more, terrific timing once more
full ball outside off, sliced towards point
length ball on the pads, a wrisiy hit sends the ball racing towards the square leg boundary, Pollard was racing across from long leg but the timing on that was top class
Malinga is back as Mumbai try to stop the carnage, starts with a short of length ball that is defended towards point
defended to the off side, some relief from the mayhem
pitched up and this is thumped over wide mid-on for four more, Delhi have galloped to fifty, Jayawardene sports a big grin as he punches gloves with Sehwag
down the leg side once more, swept past short fine leg for four more, if this is a strategy from Munaf to target leg stump, it is time he changed it, it is clearly not working for him
shifts his line towards off, a wristy stroke towards square leg for a single
Delhi running away with it here, once more on the leg stump, easy for Sehwag to help it past short fine leg for four
whipped away past point for four, Munaf continues to target leg stump, past midwicket for four, he now has the most boundaries in IPL
full ball just outside off, beautiful straight drive from Jayawardene, Bumrah can only watch it speed past him for four more, this is an expensive over
shortish ball outside off, mistimed towards cover for a single
shot! a length ball and that is all too easy for Sehwag, swings his arms to deposit it over the long-on rope, just past the rope, Delhi getting a move on

the timing is poor as he tries another lofted hit, it was a full ball and Sehwag slices it wide of extra cover, Tendulkar gives chases and pulls it in, Jayawardene wanted the third, Sehwag was never interested, he's never been one for quick running
scythed over cover for four, typical Sehwag strike, it was pitched up and Sehwag just makes a bit of room and launches that over the infield
Bumrah continues, 136.3kph, again well wide of the crease as he delivers, full ball is pushed towards extra cover
again down the leg side, helped along towards deep square leg
looks to whip this one off the back foot, but is struck on the pads, that was sliding down the leg stump
shortish and on leg stump, looks to pull that one, but bottom-edges it
whacked behind square leg for four, not too short from Munaf but short enough for Sehwag, powered past a diving Rayudu
moved across and guided it down towards short fine

dropped, short of length ball on the pads, should have been put away for four, fine leg was in the circle and instead of placing it either side of him, Sehwag picks him out, it is low but should have been taken, strikes Bumrah on the knee as he looked to catch that, Munaf is not amused
stylishly put away by Mahela, moves across to that length ball and whips it to the wide long-on boundary, one bounce and over the rope
opens the face to steer the ball towards backward point
length ball outside off, scooped just wide of extra cover for a couple, just cleared the man at extra
wide outside off, Munaf nearly makes a hash of a simple fielding stop at third man
Bumrah bowls from wide of the crease, angling in and that is defended towards cover
not much, it was short of length and outside off, Sehwag chases and misses
starts poorly, with a no-ball, angling in towards middle, defended to the off side
tucked away to the right of mid-on for a single
short of length ball outside off, pinged towards point by Sehwag
back of a length ball on off stump, worked to the leg side for the first run
length ball on middle and leg, clipped towards midwicket, can't get it wide of the fielder, diving stop by Rayudu
and again, 138.8 kph, tight around off stump, blocked towards point by Jayawardene
Malinga starts off with a length ball that is defended by Mahela
